Phase 73 plan: docs/phases/subagent-kit.md. Ships three cheap, write-less helpers in the tagteam Claude Code plugin (plugin/agents/): tagteam:test-runner (haiku; focused runs → counts, failing ids, failure tails; never fixes, never the full suite), tagteam:verifier (sonnet; one claim → CONFIRMED/REFUTED/UNVERIFIABLE with evidence), tagteam:explore (haiku; pointers not dumps, tagteam-aware). All: tools Bash/Read/Grep/Glob, disallowedTools Write/Edit/NotebookEdit.

Read-only enforcement (frontmatter can't set env or hooks for plugin agents — plugins-reference): a session-level PreToolUse Bash hook in plugin/hooks/hooks.json with a shell prefilter (only payloads whose agent_type starts with `tagteam:` reach Python) → `tagteam hook pre-tool-use` returns updatedInput `export TAGTEAM_READ_ONLY=1; <command>` (covers compound commands; idempotent); fail-closed deny when tagteam is missing or input unparseable for a kit agent. Stated limit: a helper could `unset` it; the CLI's own read-only guards do the refusing.

Contract: SKILL.md "Read-only helpers" names the kit and when to use each (rules unchanged: one full-suite run per submission; helpers never write a cycle); packaged copy + parity test + shipped-docs audit. Doctor: one line on kit availability. No pyproject change (plugin reaches users via the marketplace).

Verification: agent files pinned; hook unit tests on real-shaped input (rewrite, compound, idempotent, pass-through for non-kit and main session, deny on malformed, prefilter doesn't start Python — timed, tagteam off PATH), fail-closed without the CLI; one LIVE check in a real Claude Code session (`claude --plugin-dir plugin`): verifier's `echo $TAGTEAM_READ_ONLY` prints 1 and `tagteam cycle add` is refused. If updatedInput / agent_type prove missing live, fallback = deny unless already prefixed (agents told to prefix).

Arbiter decision (2026-09-24): NO before/after A/B — savings unmeasured at merge, said so in the closeout; measured later via `tagteam usage --by model` on real headless turns. Open for review: hook cost on every Bash call (prefilter); explore vs built-in Explore.
